subject: Governance review & exec sync — steering committee agenda and attendees
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@storix.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Governance review & exec sync — steering committee agenda and attendees

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Who we expect in the steering committee: you (exec sponsor), the economic buyer (CFO/finance), security lead, procurement lead, and one platform engineer for technical clarifications.
2) Primary decision criteria you mentioned: cost per inference, latency SLA, and data residency controls.
3) Security evidence you asked for: SOC 2 summary, runtime audit log examples, and a brief on private deployment options.

Attachments: I’ve attached a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and a SOC2 one-page summary (SOC2_highlevel_summary.docx).

Proposed steering committee agenda (high level):
- 10m introductions & success criteria (you)
- 20m technical fit and privacy/security guardrails (Redwood + your security)
- 20m commercial & procurement checklist (pricing, contract path, SOW)
- 10m rollout timeline and next milestones

Can you confirm who from Storix will represent finance/economic buyer and procurement? Also, two candidate time slots for the exec sync: Sept 2, 10:00am PT or Sept 8, 4:00pm PT. Which works best?

If you prefer, we can extend the MAP with responsibilities and dates prior to the meeting — I’ll own that doc once we agree on attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the steering group on the same page.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf, SOC2_highlevel_summary.docx
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@storix.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Governance review & exec sync — steering committee agenda and attendees

Markus — thanks for the clear recap and the materials, useful. A couple quick notes: 

- Economic buyer: Daniel Park, our CFO, will be the ultimate approver for committed spend. I’ll loop him in but he prefers a short read-ahead before the meeting.
- Procurement: please include Aisha Rahman (procurement lead) — she’ll own contractual questions and preferred procurement path (blanket PO vs SOW).
- Security: include Tomas Rivera (head of information security) for the technical evidence review.

Both proposed times could work; Daniel is leaning toward Sept 2 but I need to confirm with Aisha and Tomas. Can you add a short read-ahead (1 page) that highlights the decision asks (budget ballpark, timelines, needed compliance evidence)? That will help Daniel sign off.

Also, can you call out the fallback plan if we need to pilot in a dedicated capacity vs hosted? A quick bullet would be helpful in the MAP.

I’ve copied the names above so you can include them on invites.

—Laura
Laura Chen
VP Product, Storix Health
laura.chen@storix.com | (617) 555-4443

Thanks — forwarding Laura for awareness.
